description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of tokens and a value represented on the y-axis for different data sources. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Tokens" and has a linear scale ranging from 100 to 900, with tick labels at intervals of 100. The y-axis has a linear scale ranging from 10 to 50, with tick labels at intervals of 10, and is not explicitly labeled. 

The blue line, representing "Tutorials," is solid and begins at approximately 22 when the number of tokens is 100, increasing to approximately 44 when the number of tokens is 900. The red line, representing "Library Documentation," is solid and starts at approximately 31 when the number of tokens is 100, increasing to approximately 43 when the number of tokens is 900. The orange line, representing "StackOverflow posts," is solid and begins at approximately 33 when the number of tokens is 100, decreasing to approximately 27 when the number of tokens is 900. The green line, representing "Github files," is solid and starts at approximately 32 when the number of tokens is 100, increasing to approximately 42 when the number of tokens is 900.
